business_problem: Wistron needed to scale production of NVIDIA AI infrastructure while improving quality, energy efficiency, and worker training across global plants, but traditional CFD studies, sparse defect data, and reactive factory operations could not keep up with the speed of new AI-hardware programs.
solution_summary: Wistron built a digital-first manufacturing platform around NVIDIA Nemotron, Cosmos, Omniverse, Metropolis, and PhysicsNeMo so it could design and operate factories as continuously updated digital twins. The 324,000-square-foot Fort Worth plant was simulated before opening, and those same twin models now validate assembly lines, operating procedures, and burn-in test rooms for GB300 and Vera Rubin systems. PhysicsNeMo shortens computational-fluid-dynamics studies from hours to seconds, while Cadence Reality Digital Twin models and factory sensor streams keep cooling and quality-control processes synchronized with live operations. For visual inspection, Wistron uses Cosmos- and TAO-based synthetic data generation to train automated optical inspection models when real defect data is scarce. The company is also layering FOX, Metropolis VSS, and NemoClaw into a factory-brain architecture so AI agents can support anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and worker onboarding.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo

solution_components.name: NVIDIA TAO
solution_components.role: Helps generate and train synthetic inspection models from production imagery.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX)
solution_components.role: Provides the orchestration layer for Wistron's planned factory brain.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NemoClaw
solution_components.role: Provides secure runtimes for factory AI agents.

solution_components.name: Apple Vision Pro
solution_components.role: Delivers AR and VR worker-training experiences tied to the digital twin.

data_flow: Design data, sensor readings, and inspection imagery flow into the Omniverse-based digital twin, PhysicsNeMo and Cadence simulate airflow and burn-in behavior, Cosmos and TAO synthesize defect data for inspection models, and FOX plus agent runtimes feed operational insights back to factory managers and trainees.
business_outcome: Wistron accelerated simulation studies by 15,000x, cut factory energy consumption by about 10%, improved defect-detection accuracy by 5% to 20%, and built a digital-twin operating model that scales from assembly-line optimization to worker onboarding across global AI-infrastructure plants.
architecture_clues: The Fort Worth factory was fully designed and simulated in Wistron's digital twin platform before going live.
PhysicsNeMo reduced CFD-style simulation workflows from 15 hours to 3.6 seconds.
The company is building a Factory Brain on FOX with Metropolis VSS and NemoClaw.
evidence_quotes: Synthetic data shortens collection time and improves accuracy.
The digital twin continuously analyzes power consumption, thermal flow, and equipment status in real time.
